A phone layout choice

How should Image Tools navigation work on phones?

Choose four tabs, a menu only, or keep all eight tabs.

Recommended: four tabs. Home, Workspace, Library, and Activity stay one tap away with readable names, while all eight places remain available.

Tap Choose this under an option, then send your answer.

Today: eight places compete for the phone's bottom bar, cutting every tab name down to two or three letters. Desktop is unaffected.

Recommended

Four tabs + menu

Next: Keep Home, Workspace, Library, and Activity in the bottom bar; put Select, Compare, Models, and Settings in the top-left menu.

Editing stays one tap away with readable names; the other four places take two taps.

Menu only

Next: Remove the bottom bar and put all eight places in the top-left menu.

This gives the image more room; every place takes two taps to reach.

Keep all eight tabs

Next: Leave the current phone navigation as it is.

Every place stays one tap away, but the labels remain cut off at two or three letters.

What approval does: The experience agent updates the phone layout you choose and sends you a capture. Choosing “keep” records the current layout without changing it.

If you do not answer: the current eight-tab bar stays as it is; no layout change is made.

These are real phone captures of the current app and the three finished layout options.

Where these pictures come from

The captures show Image Tools at 390 px wide, plus close views of the bottom bar at 320 px. They include light and dark appearances. The page uses only attached captures.
